query: select coalesce(bool_or(legal_hold),false) as "legal!", coalesce(bool_or(retention_hold),false) as "retention!" from knowledge_revision_headers header where tenant_id=$1 and (knowledge_item_id=$2 or exists(select 1 from historical_knowledge_dependencies dep where dep.tenant_id=header.tenant_id and dep.knowledge_item_id=$2 and dep.dependent_kind='knowledge_revision' and dep.dependent_id=header.revision_id))
